name: ONF ~Tatakau Rasetsu e~
source:
Mizuka and Akane routes are retold with health bar concept, parody and numerous immediate death situations.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/03/vn-of-month-august-2001-kimi-ga-nozomu.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
以血條機制、戲仿元素和大量即死情節，重新演繹瑞佳線與茜線的故事。
